Hi Mina,

Following up on invoice INV-4412 (EUR 89,000) — it's now 45 days past due. Our AR team has placed a VAT hold because we don't have the vendor VAT certificate on file (EU local compliance). We've temporarily put the payment on hold until we get evidence; this is stopping the remittance on our side.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept a split payment schedule or provide the VAT registration certificate (or equivalent) so we can release the hold? If Redwood can offer a short-term payment plan / bridge, I can present it to our CFO for approval and expedite the first tranche.

Attachment: [INV-4412.pdf (invoice)]

Thanks,
Emma Novak

Emma — thanks for the note and the invoice. Sorry to hear it's in a hold state. We can work with a phased remit to avoid service interruption. Proposed terms: 

- 50% payment by 2027-06-20
- Remaining 50% by 2027-07-10
- Conditional on receipt of the VAT registration/certificate before the first tranche clears

I'm looping in Marcus (Revenue Ops) and Laura (Finance) to confirm short-term credit approval and to finalize a one-time amendment to terms. If that works, we'll prepare a DocuSign amendment so you can sign and we can avoid further collection steps.

Attachment: [redwood-vat-request-form.pdf]

Please confirm the timeline on your side and whether the CFO will accept a two-tranche plan.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>

Date: 2027-06-13T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment bridge request & EU VAT proof needed — NovaMed

Thanks Mina — quick internal decision: authorize a one-time bridging credit up to EUR 45,000 (50% of the outstanding) under the following conditions:

1) NovaMed signs the payment amendment (DocuSign) agreeing to the two-step schedule (50% / 50%)
2) VAT evidence (certificate or EU VAT ID) is received and validated by our finance team before the first payment clears
3) Payment link is generated by AR and first tranche is processed by 2027-06-20

Operational next steps (for clarity):
- Laura: prepare amendment and confirm VAT validation process.
- Mina: share DocuSign link to NovaMed and confirm contact for signed return.
- Emma: confirm whether the first tranche will be paid via bank transfer or card so we can issue the payment link.

Once the above are satisfied, pause formal collection escalation and mark the account as 'in-repayment'. If any item fails (no VAT evidence, no signed amendment), we resume the prior escalation path.
